method: Supabase connector read-only SELECT of storage.objects LEFT JOIN public.hermes_jobs; metadata only

access_probe.method: HTTP GET to authenticated object endpoint with no credentials available; not an authenticated byte download
access_probe.reason: headers must have required property authorization

query: SELECT o.name AS object_path, (o.metadata->>'size')::bigint AS storage_metadata_bytes, o.metadata->>'mimetype' AS mimetype, o.updated_at, j.id AS job_id, j.kind, j.target_key, j.source_sha256 AS recorded_sha256, j.source_bytes AS recorded_bytes, j.status AS job_status FROM storage.objects o LEFT JOIN public.hermes_jobs j ON j.source_path = o.name WHERE o.bucket_id = 'alea-hermes-source' ORDER BY o.name;
